privacyBody:
"Wasurenzo" stores all of your tasks and settings only on your own device. No account or server sign-up is required.

What we store: task content, icons, colors, due dates, completion/forgotten history, language, and theme preferences — all in local device storage.

Notifications: reminders about tasks that are about to fade are scheduled and handled entirely on your device.

Ads: the free plan may show ads through an ad network. Ad providers may collect information such as advertising identifiers to serve ads.

In-app purchases: Premium purchases go through the Apple App Store / Google Play. Payment details are handled by the store and are never collected directly by this app.

Contact: if you have questions, please reach out via the contact details in the app listing.
termsBody:
These Terms govern your use of "Wasurenzo" (the "App").

Use of the App: this is a personal task-management app. The developer is not liable for damages arising from your use of the App.

Premium plan: monthly and yearly Premium subscriptions renew automatically and can be cancelled anytime from your store account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period.

Prohibited uses: unauthorized use, reverse engineering, or redistribution of the App to third parties is prohibited.

Changes: these Terms may change without prior notice. Continuing to use the App after changes means you accept the updated Terms.
